# R&SVP – Hio Ridge

> A restored 1820 barn on 22 acres in Bridgton, Maine, for weddings, showers, reunions, retreats and small concerts. Up to 135 guests, May through October. Schedule a tour.

- Address: 437 Hio Ridge Road, Bridgton, ME 04009
- Phone: 207.400.6353
- Email: Susan@437hioridge.events
- Capacity: 135
- Season: May through October, Sunday through Friday
- Alcohol-free venue
